svg.title: White Over Black
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. White upper painted band retained. Museum full reference is tightly photographed but shows the entire rectangular painted surface. Band proportion approximate; physical size uses image dimensions, not frame. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
